title: Just published this AI Game
author: sparedk
selftext: Have a look at this guys, worked on it for quite a while. I tried my best to not make the actual gameplay AI slop.

comments.author: mskuchiki
comments.body: tried playing but for now you are lacking proper mobile support. the pieces get distorted at portrait mode and being unable to zoom in at pieces or the final puzzle image makes it quite impossible to play in small screens.

replies.author: sparedk
replies.body: Taking that into account on the next update.

comments.author: AnywhereHorrorX
comments.body: Nice, you can get infinite hints 😃

replies.author: sparedk
replies.body: Yeah still figuring out the issues with ads

comments.author: Am094
comments.body:
Too lazy to find proper icons so you default to normal emojis? Ya you tried really hard..

🤮

replies.author: sparedk
replies.body: I did, provided I am figuring things out. Maybe try getting good icons for every menu supporting desktop/Android yourself for free?

replies.author: Am094
replies.body:
You said you're an experienced game developer.

> Maybe try getting good icons for every menu supporting desktop/Android yourself for free?

They're icons dude. Either vector or raster. You can find non commercially licensed ones or commercially licensed ones. I mostly license all of mine. If I was making a game, I'd make my own icons or top level assets myself in using a combination of photoshop, illustrator, ae, to 3d modeling tools. Or I get compatible licensed assets.

Don't misrepresent yourself. You're not experienced. You're a beginner.

replies.author: sparedk
replies.body: True that I am, but I'm not an AI prompt engineer. It's not just getting the icons, it's getting them in correct resolutions, positions, anchors,etc. Since I have a job, it's hard to make that much of time as this is more of an experiment.

replies.author: Am094
replies.body:
> it's getting them in correct resolutions, positions, anchors,etc.

.....

replies.author: Original-Professor23
replies.body: Jesus christ bro, he is doing a hobby, not fucking your wife, relax.

replies.author: Am094
replies.body: Well if he fucked my wife with generic emojis but claimed he was Johnny sins, then I wouldn't feel happy either.

comments.author: Darknessborn
comments.body: Its cool that you did this and especially great if it's your first go! However it seems quite low effort to me if I'm honest, like you've let the AI use defaults for everything? AI game Dev is great but you need to be the creative director in my opinion. You can see this difference really well on www.skiptstone.co.nz where the 'zaci boom' game is similar to yours (AI left to do is thing) then the subsequent games I made on that page are much better as I made all the tiny decisions

replies.author: sparedk
replies.body:
Hey man, I appreciate your constructive tone on this one.
(Some issue with the link for me)

Your take sounds really good, as not a lot of GameDevs are open to working with AI as of now (maybe I haven't come across many of them).
I'd say yes, but it was unintentional as I just wrapped it up as an experiment.

I've been working on my next AI game and I can be confident in it's holistic appeal.

Would love to see what you're upto though!

replies.author: Darknessborn
replies.body:
Weird, if you drop the www it works. 

Yeah it's a great experiment for sure! I have maybe 5 simple but thought out games on that site. Each was a 'solo game jam' kinda, like one was 'under 300kb', another was a working simulated economy, another was MMO..., This all lasted up to a real, big game that's taken a full year to create called Remember to Die RTD.skipstone.co.nz using the Godot game engine, it's finally on Steam for wish listing. If you're interested in AI game Dev there is a devlog there you could be interested in too. 

Always happy to chat too, have been doing this for about 18m now so have a little experience to share.

replies.author: sparedk
replies.body:
Thanks!
I will take a look into that for sure! That's pretty interesting.

I do post my progress in multiple platforms. I will get back to you for a conversation definitely!
